keyQuotes: The dialog box is just the appetizer of the AI era; truly taking over workflows is Codex's ambition and the ultimate watershed for enterprise AI.
Codex's pivot also has a clear competitive backdrop.
OpenAI hopes to use the super app to bring Codex to over 900 million consumer users to scale its revenue.

mainPoints.explanation: Users no longer need to switch between ChatGPT and Codex. Codex's Agent capabilities will cover desktop, mobile, and enterprise tools like Excel and Slack, making ChatGPT a unified work interface.
mainPoints.point: OpenAI integrates Codex into ChatGPT, pivoting product logic entirely toward an Agent platform.

mainPoints.explanation: Targeting roles such as data analysis, sales, and investment banking, the Codex plugins bundle relevant apps, skills, and workflows, covering 62 popular applications and 110 skills, designed to adapt to existing enterprise working methods.
mainPoints.point: Six role-specific plugins are released, taking Codex from a general-purpose tool deep into enterprise workflows.

mainPoints.explanation: Sites allows Codex to output interactive websites or light apps, replacing traditional documents; annotations enable users to precisely mark up and locally modify AI-generated content, improving collaboration efficiency.
mainPoints.point: Sites and annotations features change the form of AI deliverables and the way of collaboration.

mainPoints.explanation: Claude Code's lead in coding tools prompted OpenAI to restructure its team, position Codex as the core execution layer, and leverage ChatGPT's massive user base to expand its share of the enterprise AI market.
mainPoints.point: The integration of Codex is a competitive response to Anthropic's Claude Code lead.

oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI announced the integration of Codex into ChatGPT, along with six new role-specific plugins and features like Sites, marking a strategic shift from a general-purpose conversational interface to an enterprise workflow Agent platform, directly competing with Anthropic's Claude.
originalTitle: 一夜之间，ChatGPT 变成了第二个 Claude
summary: This article details a series of product updates announced by OpenAI in June 2026. The core change is the integration of Codex into ChatGPT, upgrading it from a conversational interface to a unified Agent workspace. The article reveals Codex's rapid growth metrics (5 million weekly active users, 20% non-developer users) and highlights six new role-specific Codex plugins (Data Analysis, Creative Production, Sales, Product Design, Public Stock Investment, and Investment Banking), along with two new features: Sites (converting outputs into interactive websites/light apps) and annotations (precise markup and modification). The article also delves into the competitive context behind OpenAI's move: Anthropic's Claude Code has taken the lead in coding tools, prompting OpenAI to restructure its team, position Codex as the core execution layer, and leverage ChatGPT's 900 million user base to expand enterprise revenue. The article concludes that the shift from conversation to workflow Agent represents a critical watershed in the competition between OpenAI and Anthropic.
title: Overnight, ChatGPT Turned into the Second Claude
